no-restricted-syntax.message: Use theme tokens (bg-void, text-text-primary, text-text-muted, border-border-strong, text-danger, text-success, text-neon-cyan, text-neon-red, text-accent-2) instead of hardcoded Tailwind palette colors. See scripts/audit-security-lint.mjs and client/tailwind.config.ts.
Use theme tokens instead of hardcoded Tailwind palette colors in template literals.
Arbitrary CSS color values (e.g. bg-[#fff], shadow-[rgba(...)]) are forbidden — use CSS vars (e.g. var(--neon-cyan)) or theme tokens.
